{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- Circuit Breaker State
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState      :: IORef CBState
  , cbFailures   :: IORef Int
  , cbLastFail   :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbThreshold  :: Int
  , cbTimeout    :: NominalDiffTime
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold timeout = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  st <- newIORef Closed
  fc <- newIORef 0
  lf <- newIORef now
  return $ CircuitBreaker st fc lf threshold timeout

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  modifyIORef' (cbFailures cb) (+1)
  writeIORef (cbLastFail cb) now
  fails <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
  if fails >= cbThreshold cb
    then writeIORef (cbState cb) Open
    else return ()

recordSuccess :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordSuccess cb = do
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0
  writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed

checkCircuit :: CircuitBreaker -> IO CBState
checkCircuit cb = do
  st <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case st of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFail cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          return HalfOpen
        else return Open
    other -> return other

-- Allowed redirect domains for the chat application
allowedDomains :: [Text]
allowedDomains = ["chat.example.com", "auth.example.com", "cdn.example.com"]

-- URL normalization: collapse protocol-relative and handle encoding
normalizeUrl :: Text -> Text
normalizeUrl url
  | "//" `T.isPrefixOf` url = "https:" <> url
  | otherwise               = url

-- Extract the host component from a URL for validation
extractHost :: Text -> Maybe Text
extractHost url =
  let normalized = normalizeUrl url
      afterProto = case T.breakOn "://" normalized of
                     (_, rest) | not (T.null rest) -> T.drop 3 rest
                     _                             -> normalized
      hostPart = T.takeWhile (\c -> c /= '/' && c /= '?' && c /= '#') afterProto
      hostWithoutPort = case T.breakOn ":" hostPart of
                          (h, _) -> h
  in if T.null hostWithoutPort then Nothing else Just hostWithoutPort

-- Validate that a redirect target is within allowed domains
-- Uses exact matching against the allowed domain list
validateRedirect :: Text -> Bool
validateRedirect url =
  case extractHost url of
    Nothing   -> False
    Just host -> any (\allowed -> allowed == host) allowedDomains

-- Build the redirect URL with return path for post-auth flow
buildRedirectUrl :: Text -> Text -> Text
buildRedirectUrl baseUrl returnPath =
  baseUrl <> "?return=" <> returnPath

-- Validate destination URLs in auth callbacks using same strict check
validateDestination :: Text -> Bool
validateDestination dest =
  case extractHost dest of
    Nothing   -> False
    Just host -> any (\allowed -> allowed == host) allowedDomains

main :: IO ()
main = do
  cb <- newCircuitBreaker 5 (secondsToNominalDiffTime 30)
  
  scotty 3000 $ do
    -- Health check endpoint
    get "/health" $ do
      st <- liftIO $ checkCircuit cb
      case st of
        Open -> do
          status status503
          text "Service unavailable - circuit open"
        _ -> text "OK"

    -- Chat room join with redirect after authentication
    get "/chat/join" $ do
      roomParam <- param "room" `rescue` (\_ -> return "general")
      redirectUrl <- param "redirect" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
      st <- liftIO $ checkCircuit cb
      case st of
        Open -> do
          liftIO $ recordFailure cb
          status status503
          text "Chat service temporarily unavailable"
        _ -> do
          if T.null redirectUrl
            then do
              liftIO $ recordSuccess cb
              text $ "Joined room: " <> TL.fromStrict roomParam
            else do
              if validateRedirect redirectUrl
                then do
                  liftIO $ recordSuccess cb
                  let target = buildRedirectUrl redirectUrl ("/chat/" <> roomParam)
                  redirect (TL.fromStrict target)
                else do
                  liftIO $ recordFailure cb
                  status status400
                  text "Invalid redirect target"

    -- Post-authentication callback that redirects to original destination
    get "/auth/callback" $ do
      dest <- param "dest" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
      token <- param "token" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
      st <- liftIO $ checkCircuit cb
      case st of
        Open -> do
          status status503
          text "Auth service unavailable"
        _ -> do
          if T.null token
            then do
              liftIO $ recordFailure cb
              status status401
              text "Missing authentication token"
            else do
              -- Validate destination before redirecting
              if validateDestination dest
                then do
                  liftIO $ recordSuccess cb
                  redirect (TL.fromStrict dest)
                else do
                  liftIO $ recordFailure cb
                  status status400
                  text "Invalid redirect destination"

    -- WebSocket upgrade endpoint for real-time messaging
    get "/ws/connect" $ do
      st <- liftIO $ checkCircuit cb
      case st of
        Open -> do
          status status503
          text "WebSocket service unavailable"
        _ -> do
          liftIO $ recordSuccess cb
          text "WebSocket upgrade would happen here"
